selection_decisions.name: go-api-contracts
selection_decisions.reason: Refresh implements an existing exported signature and defines supported HTTP, JSON-file, validation, and retained-state behavior. Kept the function type, Item fields and tags, module path, Write behavior, and Go 1.22 minimum.

selection_decisions.name: go-behavior-tests
selection_decisions.reason: The request explicitly changes remote refresh behavior and asks for regression tests. Used independent byte oracles, success-shaped non-200 rejection, failure-stage observations, repeated publication, and a controlled partial write.

selection_decisions.name: go-core-style
selection_decisions.reason: Actual Go implementation and tests require idiomatic error handling, formatting, standard-library use, and the supported Go language version.

selection_decisions.name: go-interfaces-and-composition
selection_decisions.reason: Refresh uses the supplied HTTP client/context and owns acquired response bodies and temporary files. Kept the concrete client API and existing RoundTripper test seam without adding a storage interface, constructor, or global dependency.

selection_decisions.name: go-package-boundaries
selection_decisions.reason: Remote fetch/validation/publication extends this small snapshot package responsibility. Kept the cohesive operation and file representation in the existing package; no package split, facade, or new import direction was justified.

reference_decisions.reason: Failure-stage retention, real HTTP boundary, and independent file-byte oracles directly apply.
No package split or comparison of project shapes was needed for the existing reserved Refresh API.
